sn35.238:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane. atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi seyyathāpi bhikkhave cattāro āsīvisā uggatejā ghoravisā.
sn35.238:1.2: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikūlo
sn35.238:1.4: ime te ambho purisa cattāro āsīvisā uggatejā ghoravisā kālena kālaṃ uṭṭhāpetabbā kālena kālaṃ nhāpetabbā kālena kālaṃ bhojetabbā kālena kālaṃ pavesetabbā.
sn35.238:1.5: yadā ca kho te ambho purisa imesaṃ catunnaṃ āsīvisānaṃ uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānaṃ aññataro vā aññataro vā kuppissati tato tvaṃ ambho purisa maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ
sn35.238:1.6: yaṃ te ambho purisa karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti.
sn35.238:2.1: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnaṃ āsīvisānaṃ uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānaṃ yena vā tena vā palāyetha
sn35.238:2.3: ime te ambho purisa pañca vadhakā paccatthikā piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhā yattheva naṃ passissāma tattheva jīvitā voropessāmāti.
sn35.238:2.4: yaṃ te ambho purisa karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti.
sn35.238:3.1: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnaṃ āsīvisānaṃ uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānaṃ bhīto pañcannaṃ vadhakānaṃ paccatthikānaṃ yena vā tena vā palāyetha
sn35.238:3.3: ayante ambho purisa chaṭṭho antaracaro vadhako ukkhittāsiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandho yattheva naṃ passissāmi tattheva siro pātessāmīti.
sn35.238:3.4: yaṃ te ambho purisa karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti.
sn35.238:4.1: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnaṃ āsīvisānaṃ uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānaṃ bhīto pañcannaṃ vadhakānaṃ paccatthikānaṃ bhīto chaṭṭhassa antaracarassa vadhakassa ukkhittāsikassa yena vā tena vā palāyetha
sn35.238:4.3: yaññadeva gharaṃ paviseyya rittakaṃ yeva paviseyya tucchakaṃ yeva paviseyya suññakaṃ yeva paviseyya
sn35.238:4.4: yaññadeva bhājanaṃ parimaseyya rittakaṃ yeva parimaseyya tucchakaṃ yeva parimaseyya suññakaṃ yeva parimaseyya.
sn35.238:4.6: idāni ambho purisa imaṃ suññagāmaṃ corā gāmaghātā pavisanti
sn35.238:4.7: yaṃ te ambho purisa karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti.
sn35.238:5.1: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnaṃ āsīvisānaṃ uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānaṃ bhīto pañcannaṃ vadhakānaṃ paccatthikānaṃ bhīto chaṭṭhassa antaracarassa vadhakassa ukkhittāsikassa bhīto corānaṃ gāmaghātānaṃ yena vā tena vā palāyetha
sn35.238:5.2: so passeyya mahantaṃ udakaṇṇavaṃ orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ
sn35.238:5.3: natthassa nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā apārā pāraṃ gamanāya.
sn35.238:5.4: atha kho bhikkhave tassa purisassa evamassa
sn35.238:5.5: ayaṃ kho mahā udakaṇṇavo orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ natthassa nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā apārā pāraṃ gamanāya
sn35.238:5.6: yannūnāhaṃ tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ saṅkaḍḍhitvā kullaṃ bandhitvā taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ gaccheyyanti.
sn35.238:6.1: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ saṅkaḍḍhitvā kullaṃ bandhitvā taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ gaccheyya tiṇṇo pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
sn35.238:7.1: upamā kho myāyaṃ bhikkhave katā atthassa viññāpanāya
sn35.238:7.3: cattāro āsīvisā uggatejā ghoravisāti kho bhikkhave catunnetaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ adhivacanaṃ
sn35.238:8.1: pañca vadhakā paccatthikāti kho bhikkhave pañcannetaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ adhivacanaṃ. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn35.238:9.1: chaṭṭho antaracaro vadhako ukkhittāsikoti kho bhikkhave nandirāgassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:10.1: suññagāmoti kho bhikkhave channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:10.2: cakkhuto cepi naṃ bhikkhave paṇḍito byatto medhāvī upaparikkhati rittakaṃyeva khāyati tucchakaṃ yeva khāyati suññakaṃ yeva khāyati. sotato cepi naṃ bhikkhave paṇḍito byatto medhāvī upaparikkhati rittakaṃ yeva khāyati tucchakaṃ yeva khāyati suññakaṃ yeva khāyati. ghānato cepi naṃ bhikkhave paṇḍito byatto medhāvī upaparikkhati rittakaṃ yeva khāyati tucchakaṃ yeva khāyati suññakaṃ yeva khāyati.
sn35.238:10.3: jivhāto cepi naṃ bhikkhave. kāyato cepi naṃ bhikkhave.
sn35.238:10.4: manato cepi naṃ bhikkhave paṇḍito byatto medhāvī upaparikkhati rittakaṃ yeva khāyati tucchakaṃ yeva khāyati suññakaṃ yeva khāyati.
sn35.238:11.1: corā gāmaghātāti kho bhikkhave channetaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:12.1: mahāudakaṇṇavoti kho bhikkhave catunnetaṃ oghānaṃ adhivacanaṃ
sn35.238:13.1: orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayanti kho bhikkhave sakkāyassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:14.1: pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayanti kho bhikkhave nibbānassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:15.1: kullanti kho bhikkhave ariyassetaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn35.238:16.1: hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamānoti kho bhikkhave viriyārambhassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.238:17.1: tiṇṇo pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇoti kho bhikkhave arahato etaṃ adhivacananti.
